instances.name: RNG

requirements: Require a verified RNG clock; RNG_CLK must not be less than HCLK/16. A clock-gate write alone is insufficient.
Enable the AHB2 RNG gate and RNGEN, leave interrupts disabled for polling.
Wait for DRDY with a bounded timeout and reject current or latched clock/seed errors before consuming DR.
Discard the first sample after enable but retain it for the continuous comparison; reject consecutive equal samples.
On seed error discard output, clear SEIS and restart RNGEN; report persistent faults.
These checks do not establish cryptographic certification or physical clock qualification.

requirements: Requires separately reviewed package AF mapping, board pins, electrical levels and peer timing; this mode establishes controller semantics only.
Enable the instance APB clock, select SPI mode and configure pins from actual board evidence.
With SPE=0 select master, full-duplex, Motorola format, frame width, peer CPOL/CPHA and peripheral-clock baud divider.
Set SSM=SSI=1 for software NSS; manage any peer chip select through a separately validated output.
Enable SPE after configuration; bound TXE/RXNE waits and drain RX on every transmitted frame.
Check error flags and follow the documented clearing sequences.
For full-duplex shutdown finish RXNE/read, wait TXE=1 then BSY=0, then clear SPE.
